title: Employees without a department
statementMd:
Some employees are not assigned to any department (`department_id` is NULL). List them.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `= NULL` never matches anything in SQL.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NULL;
```

NULL means "unknown", so comparisons with `=` yield NULL (not true). `IS NULL` is the correct test.

expected.query: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NULL;
